k:江.mnemonic: The opposite of a tsunami (氵): a small arm of water, narrow enough that the construction (工) crew bridges it with a single plank. Creek (inlet, bay).

k:衛.mnemonic: Guards in armour of tanned hide (韋) go (行) round and round the walls all night, so that nobody gets in. Defense (protect, protection).

k:担.mnemonic: At dawn (旦) the porter's fingers (扌) grip the pole and swing the load up beside his neck for the day's march. Shouldering (carry, raise, bear).
k:担.hint: Porter lifting the pole at sunrise.

k:血.mnemonic: A dish with a single drop falling into it from above: the old way of sealing an oath. Blood.
k:血.hint: A drop into the oath dish.

k:衆.mnemonic: One thread (糸) of shared blood (血) ties each person to the next, and the next, until the whole crowd in the square is one people. Masses (great numbers, multitude, populace).

k:増.mnemonic: Each day (日) the farmer carts more soil (土) onto the terrace, and each day the rice field (田) is a little bigger than before. Increase (add, augment, gain).

k:庫.mnemonic: A canopy (广) wide enough to back a whole car (車) under, with goods stacked to the rafters all around it. Warehouse (storehouse).

k:郡.mnemonic: Mister (君) Mayor looks after one borough (阝). Put several boroughs and their misters together and you get the next size up on the map. County (district).

k:差.mnemonic: Sheep (羊) stand in a row while a construction (工) worker holds his ruler against each. One is a hand taller than the rest. Distinction (difference, variation, margin).

k:旧.mnemonic: An old man leans on his stick (｜) and tells you how things were back in his day (日). Old times (old things, old friend, former).
k:旧.hint: Old man on a stick, remembering.

k:含.mnemonic: Right now (今) there is a sweet in your mouth (口), tucked in your cheek and held there. Include (contain, hold in the mouth, bear in mind).
k:含.hint: A sweet tucked in the cheek.

k:細.mnemonic: Seen from the hilltop, the paths between each rice field (田) are as slender as thread (糸), a delicate net laid over the valley. Dainty (get thin, slender, narrow).

k:量.mnemonic: At dawn (旦) the whole hometown (里) brings its harvest to the scales, and the clerk weighs each sack and writes down how much. Quantity (measure, weight, amount).

k:低.mnemonic: Before the elders of the clan (氏), even the leader (亻) bows his head right down toward the floor. Lower (short, humble).

k:席.mnemonic: Under the canopy (广) of the theatre you lay your towel (巾) over a place in the pit (凵) to mark it as yours. Seat (mat, occasion, place).

k:類.mnemonic: The merchant grades his rice (米): big (大) grains in one sack, small in another, and each kind is listed on its own page (頁). Sort (kind, variety, class).

k:器.mnemonic: A big (大) table laid with four open mouths (口): bowls, cups and pots waiting to be filled. Utensil (vessel, receptacle, instrument).
k:器.hint: Four open bowls on a table.

k:玄.mnemonic: A lid on top, and beneath it a twisted skein of dark thread, wound so tight that nobody can see what is knotted inside. Mysterious (black, deep, profound).
k:玄.hint: Dark twisted thread under a lid.

k:芝.mnemonic: A green lid (亠) rolled out over the soil and cut so short that no flowers (艹) poke above it. Turf (lawn).

k:富.mnemonic: Under one roof (宀): a rice field (田) of his own and only one mouth (口) to feed. He has more than he can ever eat. Wealth (enrich, abundant).

k:率.mnemonic: A mysterious (玄) thing about the icicles (冫) on the eaves: out of every ten (十), exactly the same number always fall by noon. Ratio (rate, proportion, factor).
k:率.hint: So many icicles in every ten.

k:難.mnemonic: Try catching a turkey (隹) on wet turf (芝) with nothing but a kitchen utensil (器). It runs, you slip, and the ladle is no use at all. Difficult (impossible, trouble, accident).
k:難.hint: Chasing a turkey with a ladle.

k:準.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) wades into the tsunami (氵) flood and stops with the water at its belly: half bird, half duck, not fully either. Semi- (correspond to, conform, imitate).

k:突.mnemonic: A big (大) spear is thrust into a dark hole (穴) to find out what lives in there. Something squeaks. Stab (protruding, thrust, pierce).

k:沢.mnemonic: After the tsunami (氵) the field never drained, and a warning flag (尸) on a pole marks where the soggy ground will swallow your boots. Swamp (marsh, brilliance, grace).

k:覚.mnemonic: You see (見) the page, shut your eyes, and a sparkle (⺌) lights up behind your forehead (冖): it is stored in there now. Memorize (learn, remember, awake).

k:証.mnemonic: Anyone can say (言) it. To show that what you say is correct (正), you must put something solid on the table. Evidence (proof, certificate).

k:奈.mnemonic: The big (大) show (示) of the old capital: a giant bronze Buddha that visitors queue to see, with deer bowing in the park outside. Nara (what?).

k:巻.mnemonic: A long sheet of writing wound up on itself like a big (大) coiled cobra (已), and tied with a ribbon. Scroll (volume, book, roll up).

k:秒.mnemonic: A few (少) grains (禾) of sand slip through the neck of the hourglass: the smallest sliver of time you can count. Second (1/60 minute).
k:秒.hint: A few grains through the glass.
